claims.text: When extending an instance, signals are combined. Use `replaceOption(signal)` to replace inherited signals, or `signal: undefined` to remove them.
Special handling for AbortSignal instances at the root options level

described.text: Similarly, passing `{signal: undefined}` or `{signal: null}` in `.extend()` does not remove parent signals from being combined via `AbortSignal.any()`.
Unwrap `replaceState` before the `key === 'signal'` branch and handle `isReplace` / `undefined` / `null` to reset the accumulated `signals` array.
